def is_valid_arrangement(arr):
    """
    Check if arrangement satisfies the constraint:
    For every consecutive triple (i, i+1, i+2):

    - Or arr[i] > arr[i+1] < arr[i+2] (valley at i+1)

        a, b, c = arr[i], arr[i+1], arr[i+2]

        is_peak = a < b > c
        is_valley = a > b < c
        if not (is_peak or is_valley):
            return False
    return True

valid_count = 0
valid_arrangements = []

        valid_arrangements.append(perm)
